description: A small project dashboard with inspect and note commands.

inspect.description: Inspect the project and show a summary card
inspect.prompt: Inspect the current project without changing files. Read the workbench:inspect skill. Report concrete findings and use plugin_ui with plugin workbench, kind card, to show a concise summary.

note.description: Show a note in the workbench panel
note.prompt: Use plugin_ui with plugin workbench and kind panel to show the user's note. This is temporary UI state, not a saved file.
